item.title: My First Post
item.description:
Hello World!

This is my first blog post on my self-hosted Hugo blog.

I’m a 2nd-year Computer Science student passionate about Cybersecurity, Systems Programming, and AI. I built this blog using Hugo to document my learning journey and showcase my hands-on projects.

️ Current Focus: Cybersecurity & Practical Skills

I am currently studying for the Google Professional Cybersecurity Certificate to strengthen my theoretical foundation. However, I believe in learning by doing. Here is what I’ve been working on recently:
